name: Tiglath-Pileser
bio: Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria, also called Pul, first invaded Israel in Menahem's reign; Menahem bought his support with a thousand talents of silver raised from Israel's wealthy, and Tiglath-Pileser withdrew without staying in the land (2 Kings 15:19-20). Later, in Pekah's reign, Tiglath-Pileser returned and captured Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee, and all the land of Naphtali, carrying the people into exile in Assyria (2 Kings 15:29). His continued pressure on Israel and Judah, and his dealings with King Ahaz of Judah, are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
